parameters.name: DbInstType
parameters.description: Storage layer type. Valid values: **POLARDB** or **RDS**.

parameters.name: DrdsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of a DRDS instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the returned page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: The ID of the storage or cluster.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds describe-db-instances --drds-instance-id drds000000000000 --search pc-000000000000000 --db-inst-type POLARDB --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds DescribeDbInstances --region cn-hangzhou --DbInstType POLARDB --DrdsInstanceId drds000000000000 --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Search 'pc-000000000000000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
